inputs.prompt: Change the camera angle from <image2> to <image1>. Image 1 is a 3D Gaussian splatting color render of the REQUIRED target camera viewpoint. Image 2 is the original reference photograph of the same person, to preserve identity, natural eyes, nose, mouth, blonde hair, gray sweater dress, skin colors, shoes and details. Image 3 is the corresponding black-background grayscale Z-depth image of image 1: brighter means nearer to the camera. Use this image only to understand silhouette, occlusion and 3D relief; NEVER copy its gray values as material colors. Keep the exact pose, clothing boundaries, viewing direction, visible facial features, head direction and occlusions shown in image 1, even when the reference face in image 2 looks toward the camera. The intended target view is front three-quarter view as in source photo. Do not add a frontal face in a profile or show duplicated eyes, mouths or noses. Generate a detailed full-resolution 1024 pixel square photographic image. Use original photo texture details for eyes, face, hair, skin and clothing while retaining the target-view camera. Remove the soft 3DGS watercolor blur; generate crisp coherent texture and anatomically plausible features ONLY visible in this camera. One single photorealistic full-body person on a uniform neutral gray background; exact framing; no other subjects, panels, text, graphics, depth-map colors or diagrams.
